module: Simple pacenote generator: from a list of driveline points, it detects left/right corners by computing, for each point, the circle through three points (the point and those `lookAheadContext` indices before/after, in 2D). Nearly straight areas are filtered out, then consecutive segments of the same direction are merged. Used by the rally editor's generation tool.
usage:
local gen = require('gameplay_rally_notebook_pacenoteGenerator')
local res = gen.detectCorners(drivelinePoints, { straightThreshold = 8 })
for _, c in ipairs(res.corners) do print(c.direction, c.angle, c.length) end
notes: Direction: " right" or " left" (with a leading space) for a corner, "" for a straight section. Angle in degrees: positive = right, negative = left.
detectCorners fills in the params table passed as an argument (it is modified in place with the default values).
The first/last two points receive no direction data; the split into corners stops 3 points before the end of the list.
If pointList is nil or has fewer than 3 points: 'E' log and result { sections = {}, corners = {} }.

defaultParams.desc: Default parameters: lookAheadContext = 7 (number of points before/after for the circle), straightThreshold = 5.0 (angle in degrees below which a section is considered straight), mergeDistanceThreshold = 0.2 (m, distance to the line for merging straight sections), maxSimplifyIterations = 10.

detectCorners.desc: Detects corners along a driveline. Returns `sections` (all sections, straights included, for debug drawing) and `corners` (only those with a direction, pacenote candidates). Each section contains pos, posEnd, direction, angle, length and nodes.

pointList.desc: List of points: tables with a .pos field, or vec3s directly.

params.desc: Override of defaultParams (lookAheadContext, straightThreshold, mergeDistanceThreshold, maxSimplifyIterations).
